name: runnir
description: Drive Runnir from Codex: read GitHub Actions runs and logs, plan what a pull request or push starts, run workflows locally with act, and fill in the values of local runs.

interface.shortDescription: GitHub Actions runs, logs and local runs from Codex
interface.longDescription: Runnir is a macOS app for GitHub Actions. With this plugin Codex reads a workspace's runs on GitHub with their jobs and logs, plans what a pull request, push, merge or tag starts, runs those workflows on your Mac with act and follows them, starts, cancels and re-runs workflows on GitHub, and saves the secrets and variables of local runs after you confirm them in Runnir. Needs Runnir in /Applications.
defaultPrompt: Why did the last CI run of this branch fail?
Run this branch's pull request workflows locally with Runnir.
Set up the secrets and variables Runnir's local runs of this repository need.
